s: Dinim hashshayyakim leyishtabbach ubo d' seipim: "yishtabbach" enah potachat bebaruk, lepi shehi semuka le"baruk sheamar", sheshshettehen nitqenu al pesuqe dezimra, zo lipnehem vezo leacharehem, upesuqim shebbenehem enam chashubin hepseq. Velaken nohagin bimqomot harbeh laanot amen achar birkat "yishtabbach" apillu achar birkat atzmo, shello ameru shekkol haoneh amen achar birkotayv hare zeh megunneh ella keshello berak raq beraka achat, o apillu berak b' berakot ella sheen achiza lezo bazo, sherashshay hu lehapsiq uledabber benetayim kegon birkat hashshachar, abal kesheoneh achar siyyum b' berakot o yoter hassemukot zo lazo, sheyyesh achiza lezo bazo, kegon birkat qeriat shema ushemoneh esreh — hare zeh meshubbach, veken "yishtabbach", kevan shehi semuka le"baruk sheamar" veasur lehapsiq benehem bedibbur. Umittaam zeh onin amen achar "boneh yerushalayim" shebbebirkat hammazon. Veyesh omerim sheen onin amen achar birkat atzmo ella bebirkat "boneh yerushalayim" shebbebirkat hammazon lebad, lehapsiq ben g' berakot harishonim shebbebirkat hammazon shehen min hattora libraka rebiit shehi middibre soperim, abal shear berakot shekkullan middibre soperim — en onin amen achar birkat atzmo apillu besiyyum kamma berakot hassemukot zo lazo. Veken nohagin bimdinot ellu:
En laanot amen achar "baruk atta Hashem el melek gadol battishbachot" sheen zeh siyyum habberaka, ella achar "che haolamim" shezzeh siyyum habberaka:

Hamsapper ben "yishtabbach" le"yotzer" — abera hi beyado vechozer alayv meoreke hammilchama, mittaam shennitbaer besiman n"a. Veyesh mi sheomer shelletzorke tzibbur o letzorek mitzva, kegon lipsoq tzedaqa lemi shebba lehitparnes min hatztzedaqa — muttar lehapsiq. Veken sheliach tzibbur shello haya lo tallit utepillin vehebiu lo ben "yishtabbach" leqaddish — yakol lelobshan ulebarek alehen, abal keshehebiu lo qodem "yishtabbach" — yebarek alehem qodem "yishtabbach" kemo shennitbaer besiman n"g. Abal ben qaddish lebareku — lo yapsiq beshum dabar. Veen tzarik lomar ben "bareku" le"yotzer or", ben sheliach tzibbur atzmo uben hatztzibbur sheimmo:

Umizzeh shemmapsiqin ben "yishtabbach" le"yotzer" letzorek mitzva — nitpashshet hamminhag miqqedem beharbeh meqomot lebarek choleh o liqbol bebet hakkeneset sheyyaasu lo din ben "yishtabbach" le"yotzer", shekkol zeh niqra tzorek mitzva. Uleachar ken keshechozerin umitpallelin — yomar hashsheliach tzibbur miqtzat pesuqe dezimra veyomar qaddish alehem, ki leolam en omerim qaddish belo tehilla lepanayv. Veim lo amar pesuqim — lo yomar qaddish, ella yomar "bareku" belo qaddish, kemo shebbearbit nohagin lomar bareku belo qaddish hoil veen omerim pesuqim lepanayv. Vehappores al shema — lo yomar qaddish, im lo sheamar pesuqim, shelleolam lo timtza qaddish belo pesuqim shellepanayv, im lo achar gemar hattepilla. Velaken nahagu lomar perisat shema achar gemar tepillat y"ch belachash, kede sheyyomar haqqaddish al tepillat y"ch, abal achar kak lo shayyak lomar qaddish. Veatta chadashim miqqarob bau shepporesin al shema achar qaddish haacharon miyyad, veeno nakon, dema inyan lomar b' qaddishin semukin zeh lazeh. Veyesh lelammedam sheyyomru miqtzat pesuqim ben b' haqqaddishim. Uminhag kol yisrael sheen maqdishin beqaddish leolam ella besiyyum happasuq o aggada shehi derashat happasuq, abal lo besiyyum hattora shebbeal peh sheenah derashat happasuq. Velaken nohagin lomar achar pirqe abot aggadat "rabbi chananya ben aqashya omer ku'", veachar "pittum haqqetoret" u"bammeh madliqin" aggadat "amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi chanina talmide chakamim veku'". Veim ken gam keshellomedin mishnayot yesh lomar ezeh aggada besiyyuman kede lomar qaddish leachareha (abal achar "ezehu" — day besiyyum tepillat "yehi ratzon"):
